Nadia, I found four ticket numbers on Vantorre Group (parent) across the three sources. #8841 is the messy one.

| Ticket | What it is | Source |
|---|---|---|
| **#8841** (shown as **#PD-8841** in one digest) | Gate check-in problems on the Allentown/Newark kiosks. It appears in four places (details below). | Moss's digests of 4/27/26, 5/4/26 and 9/30/26, and #strategic-pod (Gideon, 7/1/26, ts 1782915420.000100) |
| **INC-4821** | Hartford status-page access problem, with a screenshot attached. Gideon logged it during the 8/3/26 kiosk outage. | #inc-vtg-hartford, Gideon, 8/3/26 11:08 (ts 1785773280.000111) |
| **VT-55120** | Root-cause ticket for the Hartford kiosk outage. Gideon says Carrowmere's gateway route finding and the reconnect log are attached. | #inc-vtg-hartford, Gideon, 10/14/26 (ts 1791986400.000123) |
| **#PD-4418** (unconfirmed) | `Carrier_Dwell_Summary` export dropping timestamps for Dock Door 9. | Moss's digest of 9/15/25 |

The four #8841 mentions:
- **4/27/26 digest:** logged as #PD-8841 for two missed carrier check-ins at Allentown (Gate 4, 2nd shift), under Parent Manufacturing Rollout.
- **5/4/26 digest:** still open, for a gate kiosk timeout at Allentown (Dock Door 12, 2nd shift).
- **#strategic-pod, 7/1/26:** Gideon says he closed it.
- **9/30/26 digest:** described as submitted by Mateo, for drivers at the Newark facility who can't select Dock Door 14. It's labelled VTG and was escalated to platform engineering.

Things to check before this goes to Mateo:
- **#8841 history:** the sources conflict. It's open on 5/4, closed on 7/1, then "submitted" again on 9/30 at a different site. That could be a reused number or a re-opened ticket, and I can't tell which from these sources. Newark is also where the 4/27 digest puts the Mobility depot, so check the 9/30 entry really belongs to the parent.
- **#PD-8841 vs #8841:** I treated them as the same ticket because the numbers match. I haven't confirmed that.
- **#PD-4418:** the digest only says "the account Nadia runs", not Vantorre. Nadia also ran other accounts then, so confirm it's Vantorre before counting it.
- **Hartford tickets:** I haven't opened INC-4821 or VT-55120 or their attachments. I'm only reporting what Gideon wrote in the channel.
- **8/3/26 digest:** the Hartford Sev 1 entry has no ticket number, so it adds nothing to the list.

I left out #4812 (Vantorre Mobility, 3/10/25 digest) and #PD-4402 (Quillfeather, 9/15/25 digest). The 3/10/25, 7/7/25, 12/1/25 and 5/3/26 digests and the cheat sheet mention Vantorre but give no ticket numbers.

I only read what you can see: #strategic-pod, #inc-vtg-hartford and the public digests. I didn't check the account ticket folders in the share, so there could be more tickets there. Let me know if you want me to look.
